title: Repair Schedule Labor Rates by Market (Cleaning and Damage Fees)
content:
The metro labor rate of a Wayfare repair schedule estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report is read from the market the reported trip started in: Denver, Salt Lake City and Las Vegas take the high-cost labor rate; Phoenix, Tucson and Colorado Springs take the mid-cost labor rate; any other market takes the standard labor rate. The labor hours of the estimate are priced at that rate.

| Market the trip started in | Code on the trip record | Labor rate per hour |
|---|---|---|
| Denver, Salt Lake City, Las Vegas | DEN, SLC, LAS | $118.00 (high cost) |
| Phoenix, Tucson, Colorado Springs | PHX, TUS, COS | $108.00 (mid cost) |
| Albuquerque, or any other market | ABQ or other | $90.00 (standard) |

The market is the metro market on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

**Where is the market read?** From the metro market the trip started in, as the trip record shows it.

**What does the rate price?** The labor hours of the estimate, hour by hour.

**What do two labor hours come to (hypothetical)?** $236.00 on a trip that started in Las Vegas, $216.00 on a trip that started in Tucson, and $180.00 on a trip that started in Albuquerque.
